historical_record.description: The City Planning Commission approved conditional use to add 5 new dwelling units and create housing not providing 25% of the units as affordable, by a lateral and rear addition to an existing 3-unit residential building, for a total of 8 units.
The property held an existing 3-unit residential building.
The City Planning Commission did not take discretionary review and approved the change of use from a 3-unit dwelling to an 8-unit dwelling.
